outputs.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic and example micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic outlines and example micrographs illustrating image spacing; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel c shows schematic and micrographs illustrating insets/magnification; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic with example grayscale micrographs; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic color-contrast circles and example micrographs illustrating channel annotation; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel f shows a schematic Venn-like diagram and grayscale micrographs illustrating channel separation; not a plot of averaged data.
Panel g shows a schematic calibration scale example with micrographs and color-bar legends; not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
